english: Report to life support services immediately - they're having a problem with a purification unit.
chinese: 立即到生命维持部门报到——净化装置出故障了。

english: Reroute the energy stabilizers. Wait two seconds and then purge 'em. The hit will cause the system to depolarize.
chinese: 重新路由能量稳定器。等两秒再排空。这一下会让系统退磁。

english: Kid, I know what this ship can and can't do.
chinese: 小子，这艘船能干什么不能干什么，我心里有数。

english: Power restored in 3... 2... 1.
Of course it worked. Now recalibrate that console, then get back here.
chinese: 当然成。现在重新校准那个控制台，然后回来。

english: The glitch is in that sector.
chinese: 故障在那个区域。

english: Nope. It's at 54%.
Now it's at 83%.
Private Mark Lorenzi, please report to medical bay 3.
chinese: 马克 洛伦齐列兵，请到三号医疗舱报到。

english: Lt.Voss, report to briefing room 8.
chinese: 沃斯中尉，到八号简报室报到。

english: Memorial Services for Colonel Westmore will be held at oh eight hundred hours.
chinese: 威斯特摩上校的追悼会将于八点整举行。

english: Bison Squad, report to walker deck 2 immediately.
chinese: 「野牛」小队，立即到二号 「步行者」甲板报到。

english: Testing launch PODs 1 and 2.
chinese: 测试一号、二号发射舱。

english: My team is pinned down by heavy fire. I'm requesting an artillery strike on a Strogg bunker.
chinese: 我小队被猛烈火力压制。请求对 Strogg 碉堡实施炮击。
speaker: Looms

english: Great, so where's my squad located?
chinese: 好，那我小队在哪儿？
speaker: Looms

english: Okay, let 'em know I'm on my way.
chinese: 行，告诉他们我马上到。
speaker: Looms

english: Thanks for the help. Looms out.
chinese: 多谢帮忙。卢姆斯完毕。
speaker: Looms

english: Crew Chief Hammond, report to walker bay 8D immediately.
chinese: 哈蒙德轮机长，立即到 8D 「步行者」舱报到。

english: A welding crew is needed in armament.
chinese: 武器舱需要一组焊接工。

english: All walkers for Bison Squad will need to be pre-prepped by oh four hundred hours.
chinese: 「野牛」小队的所有 「步行者」须在四点整前完成预备整备。

english: Specialist Herman Ways, report to the main office immediately.
chinese: 赫尔曼 韦斯专业兵，立即到总办公室报到。

english: A computer tech is needed in walker bay 6C.
chinese: 6C 「步行者」舱需要一名计算机技术员。

english: Crew Chief Hanks, call 232. Crew Chief Hanks, call 232.
chinese: 汉克斯轮机长，呼叫 232。汉克斯轮机长，呼叫 232。

english: Signal check for pestilence.
chinese: 「瘟疫」信号检查。

english: Roger that. Switching to 4 6 1.
chinese: 收到。切换到 461。

english: I'm a scout on special assignment.
chinese: 我是执行特殊任务的侦察兵。
speaker: 侦察兵

english: Tell General Harper that there should be no problem entering the Hub from the lower level.
chinese: 告诉哈珀将军，从下层进入枢纽应该不会有问题。
speaker: 侦察兵

english: The back shields cut out.
chinese: 后部护盾断了。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

english: Primary emitter is in the green.
chinese: 主发射器状态正常。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

english: Secondary emitters check out.
chinese: 副发射器检查通过。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

chinese: 百分之九十五。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

english: 18 hours, Chief.
chinese: 18 小时，长官。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

english: Check.
chinese: 检测通过。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

english: Check.
chinese: 检测通过。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

english: Check.
chinese: 检测通过。
speaker: 机甲驾驶员

english: You're needed ASAP. Colonel Westmore has been wounded in the leg.
chinese: 急需你过来。威斯特摩上校腿部负伤。
speaker: Voss

english: Westmore demanded you.
chinese: 威斯特摩点名要你。
speaker: Voss

english: Are you picking up our medical chips?
chinese: 你能收到我们的医疗芯片信号吗？
speaker: Voss

english: Good. Now establish an uplink with HQ. Voss out.
chinese: 好。现在与总部建立上行链路。沃斯完毕。
speaker: Voss

english: Nein. I don't know how to make it any simpler, you have to engage the primary override first.
chinese: 不。我不知道还能说得多简单，你得先启动主控覆写。
speaker: Strauss

english: I shouldn't have to. It's plainly obvious. Do I have to come down there and walk you through it?
chinese: 用不着我说。这明摆着的事。非得我下去手把手教你吗？
speaker: Strauss

english: Very well, Strauss out.
chinese: 很好，施特劳斯完毕。
speaker: Strauss

english: Strauss, we've been over this - it's not gonna happen.
chinese: 施特劳斯，这事我们说过了——不可能。

english: Thank you, Private Strauss. Your grievance is noted.
chinese: 谢谢你，施特劳斯列兵。你的不满我记下了。

english: Zebra 2, this is Bison 8. See anything?
chinese: 斑马 2，我是野牛 8。看到什么了吗？
speaker: 野牛 8

english: I got nothing.
chinese: 什么也没有。

english: Wait a second. I've got a reading.
chinese: 等等。我有读数了。

english: Holy shit! What IS that?!
chinese: 我操！那他妈是什么？！

english: On Venus, the city of Portsmith is scheduled to have temperatures in the low to mid 70's with rain from seven to eight am.
chinese: 金星方面，波特史密斯市气温预计 70 度出头，上午七点至八点有雨。

english: The city of New Berlin be in the mid to upper 70's and clear.
chinese: 新柏林市，75 度上下，晴。

english: And the spaceport, Aldrin, is still under repair from the meteor storm so the average temperature will be in the mid to upper 400's.
chinese: 航天港奥尔德林受流星风暴损毁仍在维修，平均气温将达 400 多度。

english: Exterior shields sustaining heavy damage.
chinese: 外层护盾遭受严重破坏。

english: Danger! Hull has been breached on decks two and three. Danger! Hull has been breached.
chinese: 危险！二、三号甲板船体破损。危险！船体已破损。

english: Shields are at 86%.
Shields at 72%, rerouting power from propulsion.
chinese: 护盾 72%，从推进系统重新供电。

english: Shields currently at 63%
chinese: 护盾当前 63%。

english: Warning. Exterior shields are at 48%.
chinese: 警告。外层护盾 48%。

english: Aft shields intermittent. Damage reported on Decks 2 and 3.
chinese: 后部护盾时断时续。二、三号甲板报告受损。

english: Warning. Shields have dropped to 29%.
chinese: 警告。护盾降至 29%。

english: Danger. Exterior shields are at 13%.
chinese: 危险。外层护盾 13%。

english: Exterior shields are down.
chinese: 外层护盾失效。

english: Paging Private Herman. Paging Private Paul Herman. Please report to General Harper's office.
chinese: 呼叫赫尔曼列兵。呼叫保罗 赫尔曼列兵。请到哈珀将军办公室报到。

english: Evac drills for decks 4 and 5 to commence at oh two hundred hours.
chinese: 四、五号甲板撤离演习于两点整开始。

english: Security, report to deck 2. A Strogg Warrior has been sighted.
chinese: 安保注意，到二号甲板报到。发现一名 Strogg 战士。

english: Condor squad, report to briefing room 4.
chinese: 「神鹰」小队，到四号简报室报到。

english: That's Matthew Kane. He's not a Strogg and he's been given full clearance.
chinese: 那是马修 凯恩。他不是 Strogg，已获完全通行许可。

english: Wolf squad, report to engineering and repel boarding parties.
chinese: 「野狼」小队，到轮机舱报到，击退登舰的敌人。

english: Roger that, control.
chinese: 收到，指挥。

english: I will be prepped for launch in two minutes, control.
chinese: 我两分钟后准备发射，指挥。

english: This is Bay 42. The pod is away. Running diagnostics for next launch cycle.
chinese: 这里是 42 号舱。发射舱已离舰。正在为下一轮发射做诊断。
speaker: 42 号舱

english: Control, I'm having a little trouble with navigation.
chinese: 指挥，我的导航有点问题。

english: I confirm that. Re-transmitting pod flight plan.
chinese: 我确认。重新发送发射舱飞行计划。

english: What has he been up to?
chinese: 他最近有什么动向？

english: Does he represent a threat?
chinese: 他构成威胁吗？

english: Keep a close eye on him. Section 13, out.
chinese: 盯紧他。13 区，完毕。

english: Don't let the Strogg makeup fool ya - he's a damn fine Marine.
chinese: 别被那副 Strogg 模样骗了——他是个顶呱呱的陆战队员。
